description: Ordered list of turns sent to the agent for each source file. All turns run on the SAME thread, in array order. Add/remove/reorder entries here to change the flow — no code changes needed. The script does not hardcode a turn count.

turns.label: Key point extraction
turns.utterance: Extract the important key points, concepts, and details from the attached file, including all table info, figure info, and chart info (with their exact values). Summarize in your own words -- do not just copy sentences or headers verbatim from the file. Ignore anything that is pipeline/extraction metadata about the file itself (e.g. a '# Source Package:' header line, a page/chart-count note, or '## Page N' markers) -- that is not real content and must not appear in your extraction.

turns.label: PDF generation
turns.utterance: Generate a PDF from the key points you just extracted. Give every page its own headline derived from the actual topic on that page -- never a source filename, a page number, or a page/chart-count note.
